race.comment: SIESTA (16) scored first-up over this course and distance then led but found one better late in the piece when extended to 1350m at Doomben last start. Back to 1200m with blinkers on looks a nice set up. Draws wide but has the speed to cross and is going to take some catching. NEVERENOUGHLEGO (13) arrived in the Garnett Taylor stable as a maiden four runs ago and is unbeaten since. Freshened up since dominating against three-year-olds over this distance at Rockhampton a month ago. Acid test today but should not be taken lightly. MERCIAN (8) closed well but found the winner too strong when resuming over 1000m here a fortnight ago. This trip has been a problem in the past but he is a mature galloper now and deserves the benefit of the doubt. NATURALLY LIT (11) couldn't replicate her astonishing win at the Sunshine Coast two back when midfield here over 1000m last time. Should appreciate the extra 200m. Last start Grafton winner MANPOWER (10) is also right in the mix.
